teaser.en: A small twining bean of the bush, filed by the Digo among the 'female' climbers.
teaser.sw: Mmea mdogo wa jamii ya kunde unaojizungusha porini, ambao Wadigo huuweka miongoni mwa mimea inayotambaa ya 'kike'.
teaser.dg: Mmea mdide wa weruni wa jamii ya kunde unaodzilinga-linga, ambao Adigo anauika kahi ya mbugu za 'chichetu'.

summary.en: This Mwadiga is Rhynchosia congensis, a twining wild bean. Pakia's appendices also record it as Chibugu chichetu, the 'female' small climber.
summary.sw: Mwadiga huu ni Rhynchosia congensis, mmea pori wa jamii ya kunde unaojizungusha. Viambatisho vya Pakia pia vinauorodhesha kama Chibugu chichetu, mmea mdogo unaotambaa wa 'kike'.
summary.dg: Mwadiga uhu ni Rhynchosia congensis, mmea wa weruni wa jamii ya kunde unaodzilinga-linga. Viambatisho vya Pakia piya vinauandika dza Chibugu chichetu, 'libugu dide ra chichetu'.

about.en: Rhynchosia congensis is a slender twining herb of the bean family. Its leaves have three leaflets, often dotted with tiny resin glands beneath, and it bears small yellow pea-flowers in short sprays, followed by small, flattened pods holding one or two seeds. The Digo recognise it by its leaves.
about.sw: Rhynchosia congensis ni mmea mwembamba wa jamii ya kunde unaojizungusha. Majani yake yana vijani vitatu, mara nyingi vyenye vitone vidogo vya tezi za utomvu upande wa chini, na huzaa maua madogo ya manjano kama ya mbaazi kwenye vishada vifupi, yakifuatwa na maganda madogo bapa yenye mbegu moja au mbili. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: Rhynchosia congensis ni mmea mwembamba wa jamii ya kunde unaodzilinga-linga. Chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu, ambago mara nyinji gana matone madide sana ga utomvu uphande wa photsi. Unalavya maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano dza ga kunde, ganayomera kpwa mafungu mafupi, na badaye kunatuluka makakaya madide sambamba genye tembe mwenga au mbiri. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in grassland, bushland and thicket, twining over grasses and low shrubs.
where.sw: Huota nyikani, vichakani na kwenye vichaka vizito, ukijizungusha juu ya nyasi na vichaka vifupi.
where.dg: Unamera nyasini, weruni na vitsakani, uchidzilinga-linga dzulu ya nyasi na vitsaka vifupi.

culture.en: Pakia explains that climbers are named with the root bugu, and that the prefix chi- marks small forms. Chibugu chichetu belongs with Chibugu (Rhynchosia velutina) and Chibugu chilume, the 'male' Chibugu (Indigofera trita).
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba mimea inayotambaa hupewa majina kwa kutumia mzizi bugu, na kwamba kiambishi chi- huonyesha aina ndogo. Chibugu chichetu kinakwenda pamoja na Chibugu (Rhynchosia velutina) na Chibugu chilume, Chibugu cha 'kiume' (Indigofera trita).
culture.dg: Pakia anagomba kukala mbugu nkuihwa kpwa madzina genye *bugu*, na kukala *chi-* mwandzoni inaonyesa aina ndide. Chibugu chichetu ni cha kundi mwenga na Chibugu (Rhynchosia velutina) na Chibugu chilume, Chibugu 'cha chilume' (Indigofera trita).

names.en: Pakia's Appendix III gives the Digo name Mwadiga, the same name used for the desert rose, Adenium obesum. Appendix V instead lists it as Chibugu chichetu. Chichetu appears to mark it as the female form, in the same way Pakia explains chilume as male, but Pakia gives no meaning for this name. Its scientific name is Rhynchosia congensis.
names.sw: Kiambatisho III cha Pakia kinatoa jina la Kidigo Mwadiga, jina lile lile linalotumika kwa Adenium obesum (mwadiga). Kiambatisho V badala yake kinauorodhesha kama Chibugu chichetu. Inaonekana chichetu kinauonyesha kuwa aina ya kike, kwa namna ileile Pakia anavyoeleza chilume kuwa ni wa kiume, lakini Pakia hatoi maana ya jina hili. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Rhynchosia congensis.
names.dg: Chiambatisho cha III cha Pakia chinapha dzina ra Chidigo Mwadiga, dzina mwenga na ra *desert rose*, Adenium obesum. Chiambatisho cha V badalaye chinauandika dza Chibugu chichetu. Neno *chichetu* rinaonekana kuonyesa kukala ni aina ya chichetu, dza Pakia anavyogomba kukala *chilume* ni ya chilume, ela Pakia kalavya mana ga dzina hiri. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni Rhynchosia congensis.

reason.dg: Rhynchosia velutina, Chibugu chisicho na neno ra chilume au chichetu
